name: ScrollPathDraw
description: A pinned SVG route draws itself in a two-color gradient as you scroll a smooth-scroll viewport, led by a glowing head dot, while milestone markers light up and their labels rise into place the moment the line reaches them.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. The SVG is role="img" with an aria-label listing every milestone in order, and the milestone labels are real SVG text; the head dot and percentage readout are aria-hidden. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move and is released at the edges so the page keeps scrolling; touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and the route renders fully drawn with every milestone visible.

propsApi.name: milestones
propsApi.description: Milestone labels placed along the route, in order.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading shown above the route (also the region label).

propsApi.name: color1
propsApi.description: Gradient start color of the drawn path.

propsApi.name: color2
propsApi.description: Gradient end color of the drawn path, also used for the head dot and active markers.

propsApi.name: strokeWidth
propsApi.description: Stroke width of the route in SVG units (the viewBox is 1000 wide).

propsApi.name: scrollLength
propsApi.description: Total scroll height as a multiple of the viewport height; larger values draw more slowly.

propsApi.name: glow
propsApi.description: Adds a soft blur glow to the drawn path and head dot.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
